FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: flesh rapid expansion I
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: All flesh buildings that grow outward grow 50% faster on this map.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: flesh rapid expansion II
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: All flesh buildings that grow outward grow another 50% faster on this map.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: efficient nutrition absorption
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Nutrition gained from corpses and flesh sacks increases by 50%. Food nutrition is unchanged.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: self-repairing flesh I
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Enables the flesh hive auto-repair switch. Each hour, up to 200 hit points are repaired for 4 nutrition.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: self-repairing flesh II
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Auto-repair capacity becomes 400 hit points per hour for 8 nutrition.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: efficient cell division
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Flesh hives produce fleshbeasts at 150% speed on this map.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: reactivation
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Each player fleshbeast has a 10% chance to create an extra puffspike when it dies.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: agility
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Small player fleshbeasts have a 20% chance to dodge any damage.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: monomolecular bone spikes
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Bone spike skills used by player fleshbeasts have 90% armor penetration.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: giant flesh expansion
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Large and giant fleshbeasts gain 2 parasitic spaces.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: nest master carapace
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Giant fleshbeasts gain +45% blunt armor, +106% sharp armor, and +54% heat armor.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: nest taming I
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Flesh hive activity rises 25% more slowly on this map.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: nest taming II
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Flesh hive activity rises another 25% more slowly on this map.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: rapid healing
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Fleshbeasts recover wounds in flesh hives 50% faster.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: fleshbeast taming I
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Player fleshbeast control decays 25% more slowly.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: fleshbeast taming II
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Player fleshbeast control decays another 25% more slowly.

FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.label: flesh shaping II
FleshHive.FleshHiveUpgradeDef.description: Flesh production outlets work another 25% faster.
